answer_text:
Great news! Here's a comprehensive guide on where to buy the latest iPhone:

### 📱 The Latest iPhone Lineup (2026)

Apple's current flagship iPhone lineup includes the **iPhone 17e** (2026), **iPhone 17**, **iPhone 17 Pro**, **iPhone 17 Pro Max**, and **iPhone Air** (all 2025).

---

### 🛒 Where to Buy

Here are the best places to purchase the latest iPhone:

1. **Apple Store (Online & In-Person)**
   - The best place to start is directly at [apple.com](https://www.apple.com/iphone/) or a physical Apple Store.
   - Apple offers two-hour delivery from an Apple Store, free delivery, or easy pickup options.
   - When you're ready to buy a new iPhone, you can trade in your current iPhone or Android device and apply any credit toward your purchase.
   - When you buy your new iPhone directly from Apple, you'll get access to **Personal Setup** — guided online sessions where a Specialist can walk you through setup and data transfer or focus on features.

2. **T-Mobile**
   - T-Mobile carries the full iPhone 17 lineup, including the iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17e, iPhone Air, and iPhone 17.

3. **Best Buy**
   - Best Buy also sells the latest Apple iPhone and accessories, including the newest iPhone models.
   - You can look for trade-in discounts as well as offers made by coverage plans, and you might consider an unlocked iPhone to gain cellular plan coverage flexibility or open-box products for discounted prices.

4. **Other Carriers** (Verizon, AT&T, etc.)
   - Major carriers typically carry the full iPhone lineup with various deals, installment plans, and trade-in offers.

5. **Amazon**
   - Amazon carries both new and refurbished iPhones. A renewed 128GB iPhone 14 Pro from Amazon, for example, starts at $439. You can also find newer models there.

---

### 💰 Price Overview

- The **iPhone 17e** is Apple's most affordable 2026 iPhone at **$599**, featuring the A19 chip, 256GB base storage, MagSafe charging, and a 48MP Fusion camera.
- The base **iPhone 17** offers a 120Hz ProMotion display for **$799**.
- The **iPhone 17 Pro** shares the same A19 Pro chip and camera system as the Pro Max in a 6.3-inch size, starting at **$999**.

---

### 💡 Tips
- If you are on an iPhone 16 or newer, it may be worth waiting to see what September 2026 brings before committing, as new models are expected.
- Check for trade-in deals and carrier promotions to get the best price!
